query: Make this an SOP toolkit item — I dropped the raw markdown and a card image in the repo root, add it to /resources/toolkit.
expected_behavior: Runs the marketing-pages repo guard (content.sh check-repo) before writing anything
Reformats the source into the toolkit schema with category set to sop, writing content/resources/toolkit/<slug>.md with required front matter (title, description, date, category) and a download field
Verifies internal links resolve and rewrites facilitron.com URLs to relative paths, then lints links with lychee
Builds a trimmed branded PDF via tron:md-to-pdf (LaTeX path) from the actionable section only, gets user sign-off, and uploads it to toolkit/downloads/ with --name
Converts the dropped-in PNG card image to webp, uploads to toolkit/ with --name, cleans up the dropped-in source files, and reports paths plus a dev test plan
